in_sanskrit.name: पद्मावती
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One born on a lotus flower

in_marathi.name: Padmaavati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmaavati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She whose name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Padma', meaning lotus, and 'Vati', meaning born. A popular name in Hindu mythology, Padmaavati is believed to be an incarnation of Goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of prosperity and fortune.
